body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, perceive ordinary sights and sounds from the point, without seeing through solid barriers. Your body remains aware and in place.

surges.html: Learn the occupied space of one ordinarily concealed creature within 1 unit of the point.

rider.title: Strain - Projection
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, you may move the viewpoint up to 2 units when you next move before your next turn; it must stay within 4 units of you.
